bootstrap.multiplicity: One prespecified primary contrast; all other metrics, tiers and domains are exploratory diagnostics.

cluster_key: cross-tier query_idx from the frozen media roster

decision.adoption: Replicate this complete comparison on the same roster before claiming reproducible benefit. Diagnose corrections and regressions; do not average away an unsuccessful replica.
decision.effect_threshold_proportion: min(0.01, 0.10 * max(0, published equal-tier exact_match - comparator equal-tier exact_match))
decision.negative_or_uncertain: Retain all results and identify a named component from the registered traces before another mechanism. Failure to meet the promising threshold does not prove there is no optimization space.
decision.promising_system: System-minus-direct primary lower bound exceeds the headroom threshold under natural and equal-tier weighting, with nonnegative official tool-accuracy and macro parameter-F1 point differences. The latter point checks are not noninferiority claims.

diagnostics: official tool accuracy and macro/micro parameter metrics
all eight tiers and three domains
Perception candidate inclusion and downstream resolution with explicit multi-action definitions
actual candidate width and selected parameter values
Reviewer and Planner target-knowledge and task-contract invocation, returned store/target/value identities and evidence reuse
Initial, attempted and operative Perception sources; actual refresh or revision routes; accepted Solver source
parse failures, output limits, abstentions and fallback

paper_reference.role: Published ceiling reference for headroom target; not a mathematical upper bound or matched model/population.

read_policy: Wait for both complete finalized manifests and their first complete official scores. Register the outcome read and bind sources before paired inspection. Keep all4000 rows and each denominator; no partial scoring or new output parsing tuned to results.
scope: Prospective Stage-2 discovery comparison of a complete on-demand scope-tools system with a freshly generated direct comparator. No component-isolation, stable-base, superiority, generalization or RL claim.
